description: A horizontal bar chart comparing a value across categories

title.description: Title text on top of the chart

legend.description: Description text shown below the chart (optional)

bars.description: The categories to compare. Bar length carries the magnitude, so every bar uses the same colour by default; there is no limit on how many categories you can show.

label.description: Name of this category, shown to the left of its bar

value.description: Value of this category, shown at the end of its bar

colour.description: Colour of this bar (optional). Leave it out for the default; set it on a single bar to pick that one out from the rest.

title: Report
